protected_evidence_first_countertest.policy: Typed mandatory evidence records are selected before query relevance; remaining slots follow the pinned upstream score order; output stays source-order and extractive; if the mandatory floor exhausts the nominal budget the projection budget expands rather than dropping mandatory evidence.
protected_evidence_first_countertest.budget_interpretation: Uses the upstream blank-line line-budget calculation; with 12 one-line blocks and separators, budget_ratio 0.40 yields nine selectable evidence blocks.
